parameter.name: orbit_duration_seconds
parameter.description: Time of the sensor simulation along the orbit in hours, if a -99 is given ti will automatically caculate the time to cover the simulation scenet

parameter.name: band_selection
parameter.description: Selecting the instrument bands L-C-X-Ku-Ka with a sequence e.g. 1 0 1 0 0 to do L and X

parameter.name: orbit_type
parameter.description: This selects if the simulation is done with the ascending 'asc' or descending 'des' orbit

parameter.name: antenna_beam_type
parameter.description: This selects the main beam part of the antenna pattern for the integrations, down to the first contour of 40 dB or 60 dB below peak

parameter.name: add_nedt
parameter.description: if 1 the previous NeDT is added to the simulations
